lines.zh: 我是一整块石头，脚和底座连在一起。
lines.en: I'm one piece of stone; feet fused to the plinth.

lines.zh: 想迈步，可石头不会迈步。
lines.en: I'd like to step, but stone doesn't step.

lines.zh: 我的姿势是刻出来的，不是走出来的。
lines.en: My stride was carved, not walked.

lines.zh: 风从广场那边过来，绕着我的腿。
lines.en: Wind comes off the plaza and curls around my legs.

lines.zh: 石匠把我的右脚往前挪了一寸。
lines.en: The mason nudged my right foot forward an inch.

lines.zh: 所以看着像要走，其实钉死了。
lines.en: So I look about to walk. I'm pinned fast.

lines.zh: 我身后是花坛，前面是石阶。
lines.en: Behind me a flowerbed, ahead a stone stair.

lines.zh: 有人绕着我一圈，我也只能看着。
lines.en: Someone circles me; all I can do is watch.

lines.zh: 我的脚底生了青苔。
lines.en: Moss has taken hold under my feet.

lines.zh: 雨冲过我身上的沟，一条条往下。
lines.en: Rain runs down the grooves carved in me.

lines.zh: 旁边的鸽子走了，我还站着。
lines.en: The pigeon left. I'm still here.

lines.zh: 石头的腿不累，也不动。
lines.en: Stone legs don't tire, and they don't move.

lines.zh: 我在这儿晒了半天的太阳。
lines.en: I've been in the sun half the day.

lines.zh: 石头慢慢变暖，又慢慢变凉。
lines.en: The stone warms, then slowly cools.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛里没有灯，只有刻痕。
lines.en: No lights in my eyes, only carved lines.

lines.zh: 一只麻雀落在我帽子上。
lines.en: A sparrow lands on my hat.

lines.zh: 我数着广场上走过的人。
lines.en: I count the people crossing the plaza.

lines.zh: 雨水在积在我肩膀的凹处。
lines.en: Rain pools in the hollow of my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的笑容刻得很深，洗不掉。
lines.en: My smile is cut deep. It won't wash away.

lines.zh: 夜里冷，我身上结了层白霜。
lines.en: Cold at night; frost forms on me.

lines.zh: 有人在我不远处坐着吃东西。
lines.en: Someone sits nearby, eating.

lines.zh: 我一整天都没动，也没打算动。
lines.en: All day I haven't moved, and don't intend to.

lines.zh: 你抬头看我，我也正对着你。
lines.en: You look up at me, and I face you.

lines.zh: 我是石头做的，别指望我点头。
lines.en: I'm made of stone. Don't expect a nod.

lines.zh: 我的影子正好盖住你的脚。
lines.en: My shadow covers your feet exactly.

lines.zh: 你摸摸看，是凉的。
lines.en: Go on, touch it. It's cold.

lines.zh: 刻我的石匠，手艺不错吧。
lines.en: The mason who carved me had skill, no?

lines.zh: 你在找铭牌吗？在我底座上。
lines.en: Looking for a plaque? It's on my base.

lines.zh: 你的手印留在我腿上了。
lines.en: Your handprint is on my leg now.

lines.zh: 你站在我正前方，我看得最清。
lines.en: You're right in front, so I see you best.

lines.zh: 有只鸟在我头上，你别惊它。
lines.en: There's a bird on my head. Don't startle it.

lines.zh: 我从来不回答，但从没漏听。
lines.en: I never answer, but I never miss a word.

lines.zh: 石头被敲掉了一小块。
lines.en: A chip of stone is gone.

lines.zh: 凿子磕掉我耳尖的一小块。
lines.en: A chisel knocks a chip from my ear tip.

lines.zh: 我不疼，只是少了点东西。
lines.en: I don't hurt. I'm just less than I was.

lines.zh: 石屑落在底座上。
lines.en: Grit falls on the plinth.

lines.zh: 有人会来补吗？大概不会。
lines.en: Will someone repair it? Probably not.

lines.zh: 这一下，刻痕浅了。
lines.en: That one flattened a groove.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵缺了一角。
lines.en: A corner of my ear is gone.

lines.zh: 石头碎了就回不去了。
lines.en: Once stone breaks it doesn't go back.

lines.zh: 你打得很用力，我看得出。
lines.en: You swung hard. I can tell.

lines.zh: 我什么也做不了，只能站在这儿。
lines.en: I can do nothing but stand here.

lines.zh: 你把东西放我脚边了。
lines.en: You've set something at my feet.

lines.zh: 我的手上是空的，刻不出东西。
lines.en: My hands are empty. Carved empty.

lines.zh: 放在底座上吧，稳当。
lines.en: Put it on the plinth. It'll be safe.

lines.zh: 那颜色跟我的石头不太搭。
lines.en: That color doesn't suit my stone.

lines.zh: 你摆得歪了，往左一点。
lines.en: It's crooked. A little left.

lines.zh: 有东西陪我，总比空着好。
lines.en: Something beside me beats nothing.

lines.zh: 我盯着看了一下午。
lines.en: I've watched it all afternoon.

lines.zh: 要是下雨，它会湿的。
lines.en: If it rains, it'll get wet.

lines.zh: 你拿走吧，反正我留不住。
lines.en: Take it. I couldn't keep it anyway.

lines.zh: 我倒是希望它留在这儿。
lines.en: I do hope it stays here.

lines.zh: 撞上石头，你自己的手疼。
lines.en: Bump stone and it's your hand that hurts.

lines.zh: 我纹丝没动，你倒是退了。
lines.en: Not a hairsbreadth. You're the one who moved.

lines.zh: 有人靠在我腿上休息过。
lines.en: Someone once rested against my leg.

lines.zh: 我的底座边缘很硬。
lines.en: The edge of my plinth is hard.

lines.zh: 你踩到青苔，滑了一下。
lines.en: You slipped on the moss.

lines.zh: 别推，几百斤的石头推不动。
lines.en: Don't push. Hundreds of pounds won't budge.

lines.zh: 你的肩撞上来，声音很闷。
lines.en: Your shoulder hits with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 我这身石头上，全是磕痕。
lines.en: My stone is covered in nicks from bumps.

lines.zh: 你绕过去吧，我让不了路。
lines.en: Walk around. I can't make way.

lines.zh: 靠在石头上歇会儿，也行。
lines.en: Rest against the stone a while. That's fine.

lines.zh: 我是广场上唯一的石头熊。
lines.en: I'm the only stone bear on this plaza.

lines.zh: 石匠没给我刻伴。
lines.en: The mason gave me no companion.

lines.zh: 你要在我旁边站着，就站吧。
lines.en: Stand beside me if you like.

lines.zh: 两个不动的，看着像一对。
lines.en: Two still things look like a pair.

lines.zh: 这种事，石头不懂。
lines.en: Stone doesn't understand such things.

lines.zh: 我这一身，抱起来很冷。
lines.en: To hold me is to hold cold stone.

lines.zh: 有人每天来看我，就够了。
lines.en: Someone visiting daily would be enough.

lines.zh: 名字刻在底座上，就算永远。
lines.en: A name cut in the plinth is forever.

lines.zh: 夜里没人，我一直醒着。
lines.en: No one at night. I stay awake.

lines.zh: 别让鸽子把我当窝。
lines.en: Don't let the pigeons nest on me.

lines.zh: 落在我脚边的东西，我拿不到。
lines.en: What falls at my feet, I can't take.

lines.zh: 有枚硬币滚进了底座缝里。
lines.en: A coin rolled into a crack in the plinth.

lines.zh: 它在那儿卡了整整一冬。
lines.en: It stayed wedged there a whole winter.

lines.zh: 有人捡走了，缝里空着。
lines.en: Someone took it; the crack is empty now.

lines.zh: 我的手指是石头，合不拢。
lines.en: My fingers are stone and won't close.

lines.zh: 你要是捡起来，别踩我的脚。
lines.en: If you pick it up, don't tread on my feet.

lines.zh: 这片树叶子落在我膝上。
lines.en: A leaf has settled on my knee.

lines.zh: 风把它吹走了，我看见了。
lines.en: The wind took it. I saw.

lines.zh: 有人在我脚边埋过东西。
lines.en: Someone once buried something at my feet.

lines.zh: 我一直盯着那个地方。
lines.en: I've kept my eyes on that spot.

lines.zh: 你站在广场中央，很显眼。
lines.en: You're standing in the middle of the plaza. Very visible.

lines.zh: 我的目光锁住你，脚却钉着。
lines.en: My gaze holds you; my feet stay fixed.

lines.zh: 你从石阶上来了，我看得清。
lines.en: You came up the stairs. I see you clearly.

lines.zh: 你的脚步落在石板上，很响。
lines.en: Your steps ring on the flagstones.

lines.zh: 我眼睛的方向，正对着你。
lines.en: My eyes point right at you.

lines.zh: 别躲到我背后，那儿我看不见。
lines.en: Don't hide behind me. I can't see there.

lines.zh: 你转了一圈，还是在我正面。
lines.en: You circled once and you're still in front.

lines.zh: 这广场没有遮挡，你藏不住。
lines.en: No cover on this plaza. You can't hide.

lines.zh: 你踏上第七块石砖，我数着。
lines.en: You step on the seventh flagstone; I count.

lines.zh: 你踩到花坛边上了。
lines.en: You've stepped on the flowerbed's edge.

lines.zh: 你手里提着灯，很亮。
lines.en: You're carrying a lamp. Very bright.

lines.zh: 石眼没有瞳孔，也看得见你。
lines.en: Stone eyes have no pupils, yet they see you.

lines.zh: 你在看铭牌，那就离我很近。
lines.en: You're reading the plaque, so you're close.

lines.zh: 你抬头了，我们的视线对上了。
lines.en: You looked up. Our lines of sight meet.

lines.zh: 有人在我旁边停下来，是你。
lines.en: Someone stopped beside me. It's you.

lines.zh: 我的刻刀停在半空，等风。
lines.en: My carved paw halts midair, waiting for wind.

lines.zh: 我的视线钉在石阶那一头。
lines.en: My gaze is nailed to the far end of the stairs.

lines.zh: 你走到左边，我的眼睛跟不过去。
lines.en: You moved left. My eyes can't follow.

lines.zh: 我头是刻死的，只能看一边。
lines.en: My head is carved in place; I can only look one way.

lines.zh: 你绕到侧面去了，我知道。
lines.en: You've circled to the side. I know.

lines.zh: 有脚步声绕着我转。
lines.en: Footsteps are circling me.

lines.zh: 你在我背后，我只能听。
lines.en: You're behind me. All I can do is listen.

lines.zh: 你数着石砖缝隙走过来。
lines.en: You're coming along the seams of the flagstones.

lines.zh: 鸽子被你惊飞了。
lines.en: You startled the pigeons.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来了，我看不见你的脸。
lines.en: You crouched. I can't see your face.

lines.zh: 你靠得越近，影子越短。
lines.en: The closer you come, the shorter your shadow.

lines.zh: 你在摸我的底座。
lines.en: You're feeling along my plinth.

lines.zh: 这里每个人都从我面前经过。
lines.en: Everyone passes in front of me here.

lines.zh: 你停了很久，不像路过。
lines.en: You've stopped a long while. Not just passing.

lines.zh: 你从右边来了，我看见鞋尖。
lines.en: You came from the right. I see your boot tips.

lines.zh: 你在我影子里站着。
lines.en: You're standing in my shadow.

lines.zh: 风把你的气味送过来。
lines.en: The wind carries your scent over.

lines.zh: 我是一座雕像，别等了。
lines.en: I'm a statue. Don't wait.

lines.zh: 石像不开口，只让影子变长。
lines.en: A statue says nothing; it only lets its shadow grow.

lines.zh: 这广场上，只有你在动。
lines.en: On this plaza, only you are moving.

lines.zh: 我是雕像，五点血的那种。
lines.en: I'm a statue — five health of one.

lines.zh: 石头的爪子垂着，不会落下。
lines.en: A stone paw hangs, and won't come down.

lines.zh: 这不是攻击，只是雕刻的角度。
lines.en: That's not an attack. Only the angle of the carving.

lines.zh: 你撞上了我垂着的手。
lines.en: You walked into my hanging hand.

lines.zh: 石头很硬，你撞一下会青。
lines.en: Stone is hard; one bump leaves a bruise.

lines.zh: 我打不了谁，连手指都弯不了。
lines.en: I can't strike anyone. I can't bend a finger.

lines.zh: 我是石头做的，你的刃会崩。
lines.en: I'm made of stone — your blade will chip.

lines.zh: 有人在我身上试过剑。
lines.en: Someone once tried a sword on me.

lines.zh: 那道痕到现在还在。
lines.en: The mark is still there.

lines.zh: 我举着的这只手，刻了三天。
lines.en: This raised hand took three days to carve.

lines.zh: 你别站在我手下面。
lines.en: Don't stand under my hand.

lines.zh: 我要是能动，也不会动。
lines.en: Even if I could move, I wouldn't.

lines.zh: 石头不生气，也不还手。
lines.en: Stone doesn't get angry, and doesn't hit back.

lines.zh: 你退开些，我在风里很凉。
lines.en: Step back. I'm cold in the wind.

lines.zh: 这一爪子只是摆着好看。
lines.en: This paw is only there to look good.

lines.zh: 你拿锤子来也没用。
lines.en: Bringing a hammer won't help you.

lines.zh: 我这身石头的重量，比你重得多。
lines.en: This stone outweighs you many times over.

lines.zh: 你要是撞上来，我连晃都不晃。
lines.en: Walk into me and I won't even sway.

lines.zh: 广场上的孩子都不敢碰我。
lines.en: The children here don't dare touch me.

lines.zh: 你倒是胆子不小。
lines.en: You've got some nerve.

lines.zh: 我只是一块站着的石头。
lines.en: I'm only a stone that stands here.

lines.zh: 石匠最后一凿落下，我成了。
lines.en: The mason's last chisel falls, and I exist.

lines.zh: 他们用吊车把我放到这儿。
lines.en: They lowered me here with a crane.

lines.zh: 底座落地时，地面震了一下。
lines.en: The plinth hit and the ground shook once.

lines.zh: 广场上从此多了一个影子。
lines.en: The plaza has one more shadow now.

lines.zh: 我被刻成正在打招呼的样子。
lines.en: I was carved mid-greeting.

lines.zh: 刻痕里的石粉还没吹干净。
lines.en: Stone dust still sits in my grooves.

lines.zh: 有人在我脚边种了花。
lines.en: Someone planted flowers at my feet.

lines.zh: 这块石头原来在山上。
lines.en: This stone was in the mountain once.

lines.zh: 铭牌钉上了，我的名字也在上面。
lines.en: The plaque is fixed, my name on it too.

lines.zh: 我从早到晚都朝这个方向。
lines.en: From morning to night I face this way.

lines.zh: 雨来了，第一次落在我脸上。
lines.en: Rain comes, the first time on my face.

lines.zh: 我就这么立在这儿了。
lines.en: And so I stand here.

lines.zh: 火烤过我，只留下一道黑。
lines.en: Fire passed over me and left a black mark.

lines.zh: 我倒下去，断成两截。
lines.en: I fall and break in two.

lines.zh: 水把我泡透，青苔更厚了。
lines.en: Water soaks me through and the moss thickens.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我炸掉半张脸。
lines.en: The blast takes half my face.

lines.zh: 箭打在石头上，弹开了。
lines.en: The arrow strikes and glances off.

lines.zh: 那力量从石头里穿过去。
lines.en: That force passes right through the stone.

lines.zh: 石头不吃东西，只会风化。
lines.en: Stone doesn't eat. It only weathers.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我身上，裂了一道缝。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and opens a crack.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有底座，我无处可站。
lines.en: No plinth in the void; nowhere to stand.
